title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: Grothendieck is axiomatizing the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli stacks M_{g,ν}. The Deligne–Mumford boundary is stratified by Mumford–Deligne (stable) graphs G; the strata are M_G. A morphism of generalization G → G' contracts a set of edges, i.e. smooths the corresponding nodes. On the previous page these graphs and morphisms form a category 𝒢 in which every morphism is an epimorphism.

Axiom (123) (Simpl). For every G, the ordered set of quotients of G is 'simplicial': it is isomorphic to the set of subsets of a finite set. Concretely, let A_G be the set of quotients ≠ G that are maximal among these. These are the one-edge contractions, so A_G is the edge set of G. The whole quotient poset is then isomorphic to P(A_G). For C ⊂ A_G, G/C denotes the quotient associated with A_G∖C. The convention is order-reversing: the bigger C, the smaller the quotient.

Data (124). For each G there are two groupoids and a morphism φ_G : SΠM_G → ΠM_G.
- ΠM_G is the fundamental groupoid of the stratum M_G.
- SΠM_G is the fundamental groupoid of the punctured tubular neighbourhood ('S' for sphere bundle / deleted neighbourhood) of M_G in the open part.
- φ_G is an extension of ΠM_G by Z^{A(G)}. Its kernel is the free abelian group generated by the commuting Dehn twists (loops around the branches of the normal-crossing boundary), one per edge. Grothendieck notes this Z^{A(G)}-structure is extra structure on SΠM_G.

Functoriality. G ↦ ΠM_G is a functor for isomorphisms and generalization morphisms. On the next page:
- G ↦ SΠM_G is a functor for all morphisms.
- For f : G → G/C there is a commutative square (125). The composite SΠM_G → SΠM_{G'} → ΠM_{G'} factors through the pushout extension of ΠM_G by Z^C, obtained along the projection Z^{A(G)} → Z^C. This is the fundamental groupoid of the deleted neighbourhood of M_G inside the closure of M_{G'}: twists around the edges that survive in G' die in ΠM_{G'}, while twists around the smoothed edges survive.
- Transitivity for composites then follows automatically.

The margin NB asks additionally for a notion of extension of SΠM_G by Z^C, compatible with SΠM_{G/C}, for every C ⊂ A_G.

Purpose: an abstract, combinatorial–groupoid model of a stratified space with normal-crossing ('simplicial') boundary. The aim is to describe the Teichmüller tower and its 'base points at infinity' purely in terms of graphs, groupoids and Z^edges-extensions.
errors: No real mathematical error. Contracting a loop edge is allowed (it raises the vertex genus), and quotients are taken as quotient objects, not isomorphism classes. With these conventions (Simpl) holds for stable graphs.

The indexing convention is confusing. G/C is said to be associated with A_G∖C, yet on the next page the morphism G → G/C uses the extension by Z^C. Read consistently, C must be the set of contracted (smoothed) edges. The labelling A_G∖C versus C is a slip or an order-reversal ambiguity in the draft.

The machine transcription reads 'non isomorphes à l'ens des parties'. The image says the ordered set of quotients *is* isomorphic to the set of parts of A_G. Read literally, the transcription inverts the axiom.

ideas.what: Category of stable (MD) graphs with generalization (edge-contraction) morphisms, all epimorphisms, whose quotient posets are Boolean lattices P(edges) — the 'Simpl' axiom
ideas.modern_name: Category of stable graphs / face poset of the tropical moduli space M_{g,n}^{trop}; generalized cone complex / symmetric Δ-complex structure of the boundary complex

missed.claim: Grothendieck abstracts the boundary combinatorics of M_{g,ν} as a category of graphs with edge-contraction epimorphisms and Boolean quotient lattices P(A_G). This is exactly the structure later used to build tropical moduli spaces as generalized cone complexes. He couples it with a Z^{edges}-extension of fundamental groupoids, i.e. the log-fundamental-groupoid / multitwist data. A single axiomatic package of 'cone complex + Z^E-extensions of stratum groupoids' anticipates a link between tropical moduli and log/Kato–Nakayama homotopy types that was made only later and piecemeal.
missed.quote: l'ens ordonné des quotients de G est "simplifié" i.e. isomorphe à l'ens des parties d'un ens fini … extension de ΠM_G par Z^{A(G)}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This gives an axiomatic recipe for reconstructing the homotopy type at infinity (and Galois actions on it) from purely combinatorial data. It is relevant to the profinite Grothendieck–Teichmüller programme, to the log-Betti realization of M̄_{g,n}, and to tropical approaches to the topology of M_{g,n}.

missed.claim: The margin NB asks for compatible extensions of SΠM_G by Z^C relating to SΠM_{G/C} for all C ⊂ A_G, i.e. a full coherent system of partial deleted neighbourhoods. This is only partly realized by (125) on the next page.
missed.quote: NB Il faudrait aussi pour tout G et C ⊂ A_G une notion d'extension de SΠM_G par Z^C … SΠM_{G/C}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: A coherent system of this kind is the groupoid analogue of the homotopy-coherent gluing of a stratified space, which is still delicate in the profinite setting.

deep.surprise_reason: The mathematics (strata indexed by stable graphs, Dehn-twist extensions) is known. What is notable is the early, clean axiomatization of the boundary as a Boolean 'Simpl' category of graphs together with Z^E-extensions of groupoids. It anticipates the tropical cone-complex and log-fundamental-groupoid viewpoints, but as an unpublished draft step rather than a finished new result.
